programs.name: SpaceWERX Technical and Business Assistance (TABA)
programs.description: Technical and Business Assistance that eligible companies can request within a SpaceWERX SBIR/STTR proposal to support commercialization needs.
programs.geography: United States; relevant to eligible Southern California applicants
eligibility: Requested as part of an applicable SBIR/STTR proposal
Subject to the solicitation and award requirements
programs.status_detail: The assistance pathway is documented by SpaceWERX; availability depends on the applicable proposal and solicitation.

programs.name: America's Seed Fund (SBIR/STTR)
programs.provider: U.S. Small Business Administration and participating agencies
programs.description: The federal SBIR/STTR framework provides non-dilutive research and development funding through agency-specific solicitations, including space-relevant topics.
eligibility: Generally no more than 500 employees, subject to detailed ownership and control rules
STTR requires a qualifying U.S. research-institution partner and defined work shares
programs.status_detail: The framework is active; applicants must identify and respond to a current agency solicitation rather than submit an unsolicited proposal.
unknowns: fit with a current agency topic

programs.name: SpaceWERX SBIR/STTR
programs.description: A recurring Space Force pathway for small businesses developing dual-use space technologies, spanning feasibility, prototype development, and potential transition.
programs.geography: United States; relevant to eligible Southern California companies
eligibility: Applicant must meet the applicable SBIR/STTR small-business rules
Applications must respond to an active SpaceWERX solicitation or topic
Some Phase II paths require a U.S. Space Force customer memorandum
programs.status_detail: The program is active, but individual solicitations have their own windows; use the live SpaceWERX page for current topics and deadlines.
unknowns: customer sponsorship for a specific path

programs.name: SpaceWERX PY26.2 TACFI
programs.description: A Tactical Funding Increase pathway intended to help eligible SBIR/STTR Phase II efforts bridge toward operational transition with matching support.
programs.geography: United States; relevant to eligible Southern California awardees
eligibility: Active SBIR/STTR Phase II or Phase II completed within the stated eligibility window
Small Business Concern must remain SBIR/STTR-eligible
Government partner coordination and matching support are required
programs.status_detail: The official SpaceWERX page states that the PY26.2 TACFI notice opened June 5, 2026 and accepts submissions on a continuous basis; dates remain subject to change.
unknowns: continued availability after the review date

programs.name: SpaceWERX STRATFI
programs.description: A Strategic Funding Increase pathway for qualifying Phase II technologies seeking larger-scale transition and public-private matching support.
programs.geography: United States; relevant to eligible Southern California awardees
eligibility: Qualifying active or recently completed SBIR/STTR Phase II effort
Government organization submits the capability package
Matching and transition support requirements apply
programs.status_detail: The program is active, but this record does not claim a currently open STRATFI submission window; confirm on the official page.

programs.name: SoCal Deep Tech Week
programs.provider: Sparrow Point Foundation / SoCal Deep Tech
programs.description: A Southern California gathering for founders, operators, funders, government program leads, and industrial partners working in deep tech, defense, aerospace, and related sectors.
eligibility: The next cohort and application rules will be published by the organizer
Some events are open by application while flagship sessions may be curated
programs.status_detail: The 2026 week has concluded. The organizer states that the next edition is planned for Southern California in 2027, with dates and host city to be announced.
